summary:
Wrote plan.md (not built or rendered yet). Six 2×2 smooth-quartz legs in three pairs, placed per a fixed leg table, pinch from 22 out at the ground to 8 at y120, then flare to 14 under a 60-wide saucer. The saucer has a ribbed underside cone, a dark glazed restaurant and deck, a halo of white fins and a stepped roof with an orange band and a dome at y235.
Glass elevators and a gold car on the north lattice core, a hexagonal SkyLine at y42–48, a round glass Pavilion with a curving slab ramp, and a spire to y258. The hourglass legs and the halo-ringed saucer are what make it read as the Space Needle. Space Needle plan: six legs compute from the architect's hourglass formula, a 7x7 iron-bar and white-concrete core carries glass elevators and a gold car, and the saucer sits on a ribbed cone. The saucer has a slatted halo of 90 fins, with a stepped roof, orange band, dome and spire above it. A SkyLine hexagon and a glass Pavilion with an accessible slab ramp complete it. Six parts, 5 rooms. elements.md and the plan.md designer sections are written.

rooms.name: SkyLine
rooms.purpose: Low hexagonal event hall in gray glass at 30 m. Banquet tables and a small bar along the glass.
rooms.ways_in: Core doorway x31..33 z29 y43..45; ladder hole x32 z34 y42

rooms.name: The Loupe
rooms.purpose: Ring restaurant under the saucer. Tables near the gray glass, a white floor, a service counter by the core.
rooms.ways_in: Core doorway x31..33 z29 y213..215; ladder hole x32 z34 y212

rooms.name: Observation deck inner
rooms.purpose: Dark-glazed lookout ring with telescopes and benches. Moody, lit from the floor.
rooms.ways_in: Core doorway x31..33 z29 y219..221; ladder hole x32 z34 y218; exits to the outdoor deck at x31..33 z11, around (50,42) and around (14,42), y219..221

rooms.name: Outdoor deck
rooms.purpose: Open-air ring walk behind a glass rail with the view, nothing but benches.
rooms.ways_in: Three exits from the inner observation wall at theta 0, 120 and 240 degrees (r 21, y219..221)

recruit.why: Stepped quartz legs with stair and slab transitions, foot pads and ties; no bare ledges.
Open lattice core, glass elevator shafts, gold car and ladder run through 220 blocks.
Continuous glass rings, mullions and the SkyLine glass wall.
The slab ramp and landing to the Pavilion door, plus the ladder holes through the floors.
Stepped roof, orange band, shallow dome and the end-rod mast with its beacon.
Hidden sea lanterns in floors, soffits and posts so no mob spawns.
